hero.desc1: Answer 5 questions. Get matched to real local jobs near you.
hero.desc2: No account. No documents. We never ask where you're from or what your status is — just what you're good at.

anonymous.title: We never ask who you are.
anonymous.desc: No name. No address. No documents. No questions about your residency, visa, or background. Just tell us what you're good at and what you're looking for. That's all we need.
